data.one_liner: Pure‑Dart implementation of the XXH3 64‑bit non‑cryptographic hash algorithm.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to compute a 64‑bit XXH3 hash from byte arrays, a hexadecimal string representation, and a streaming API for incremental hashing. The implementation runs entirely in Dart without native code.
use_when: You need a fast, deterministic hash for in‑memory data structures or caching.
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution that works on all Flutter platforms without ffi.
You want to hash large data in chunks using a stream API.
avoid_when: Cryptographic security is required (XXH3 is not a crypto hash).
You need a 128‑bit hash or other hash variants not supported.
Running on web where Dart ints exceed 53‑bit precision may give incorrect results.
strengths: No native dependencies – works everywhere Dart runs.
High throughput for a pure‑Dart implementation.
Streaming API allows hashing of large or incremental data.
weaknesses: Only 64‑bit output; no XXH3‑128 support yet.
Potential integer precision issues on JavaScript/web platforms.

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a wide range of cryptographic hash functions (e.g., SHA‑256) and works without native code, useful when security is required.
